name: managed-review-prompt-gate-contract-gaps
title: Close the managed-review prompt/gate contract gaps
description: Six managed-review gates enforce invariants that no reviewer prompt states, so a compliant-looking reviewer completes a full review and is then refused. Each gap costs one wasted review round to discover. Found during B-137a across roughly fifteen review rounds; framework-wide, not B-137a-specific. Five are prose gaps in the managed-review protocol (readCount semantics, verbatim routing-digest copy, manifest/log list equality, exactly-one submission, repository-relative paths) and the sixth, F-299, is the same failure in code: readManagedHostRunBinding trusts archive.binding after only a runId check while its sibling import-seal reader re-digests it against archive.evidenceBindingDigest.
